observed.caption: Panoramic view of a sunlit expansive valley flanked by grassy hills under a partly cloudy sky with bright sun glare.
observed.description: A wide panoramic landscape shows a broad valley floor stretching to a hazy distant horizon, flanked on the left and right by sloping grassy hills covered in dry brown-green grass and scattered rocks. Bright sunlight with glare dominates the top center of the sky, which is blue with large white and gray clouds. A small white wind turbine stands on the far right hilltop, a solitary green tree grows on the right slope, and a smaller dark shrub is visible in the center midground. The foreground is rocky grassy terrain with uneven ground and small boulders, and faint mountain ridges are visible in the far distance under the cloud cover.
